item.title: Warrior Cats Clans of the Forest
item.description:
Warrior Cats Clans of the Forest Trailer

Gameplay Programmer – Quest & Achievement Systems

Note: Action-adventure RPG based on the Warrior Cats literary universe.

Quest & Achievement Architecture

Designed and implemented a modular architecture to manage main and secondary quests across all four clans, handling complex states (quest gating, open-world triggers, multi-step progression, and den rewards).

item.title: Looney Tunes Wacky World of Sports
item.description:
Looney Tunes Wacky World of Sports Trailer

Gameplay Programmer – Challenges & Achievement Systems

Note: Multi-sport arcade title featuring 4 classic sports (Soccer, Basketball, Tennis, and Golf) set in the Warner Bros. universe.

Progression Architecture & Systems

Designed and implemented from scratch a modular architecture to track, process, and unlock dynamic achievements and challenges across all game modes.

item.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Quest for Balance
item.description:
Avatar: The Last Airbender Trailer

Gameplay Programmer & Technical Scripting

Note: Official co-op action-adventure title based on the original Nickelodeon animated series.

Dialogue & Narrative Systems

Engineered and integrated complex dialogue trees and branching narrative flows within Unreal Engine.

Hooked level triggers, audio/subtitle events, and in-game cutscenes to seamlessly align gameplay pacing with key narrative beats.

item.title: About Me
item.description:
I’m Jonatan Sosa, a gameplay and engine programmer focused on writing clean, decoupled, and high-performance code. I am motivated by collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, optimizing complex systems, and turning technical challenges into solid, memorable interactive experiences.

I graduated with a degree in Video Game Development Engineering from San Ignacio de Loyola Institute (ISIL), graduating first in my class with an academic excellence scholarship.

Passionate About Teamwork and Challenging Projects

Over the course of 6+ years, I have contributed to the development and commercial release of cross-platform titles and simulation projects.
